title: Copying a Bit String
statement: For either choice of the program parameter, every natural number $n$, and every bit string $r$, on input $r$ the program starting at its copy label with its single register equal to $n$ and input position $0$ reaches a halted state with that register unchanged, input position $|r|$, and output extended by $r$, in at most $2|r|+2$ steps. This holds for every output string already printed.
hypotheses_covered: The program parameter is a Boolean choice
The input position starts at zero
